author: bshastry
content: At the Fulu->Gloas boundary, if the last Fulu slot is skipped, the Fulu attestations for that slot (which carry EIP-7549 data.index = 0) get included in first Gloas block and are scored under Gloas rules,where data.index is interpreted as payload vote

author: bshastry
content:
Since the attestation is not same slot, this function

https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/477321355d48d527e7e1e4d572f6a40a0b41072a/specs/gloas/beacon-chain.md?plain=1#L1361-L1368

author: bshastry
content: compares legacy zero (data.index = 0) against execution_payload_availability (which upgrade_to_gloas initialized to 1 for all pre-fork slots)

author: bshastry
content: Impact: Vote mismatch and attestors lose timely head flag despite being correct

author: bshastry
content: This is a spec bug. Clients impl the spec faithfully, so they inherit the bug
